title: Whispers Before Dawn
description: Clouds part slow in twilight's grace, A mountain's hush in heaven's embrace.

description: Silence flows where waters meet sky, A silver hush as dreams float by.

description: Thunder sleeps in veiled delight, Clouds stretch wide in pale twilight.

description: The sun sinks low with amber fire, Cradled by hills in soft desire

description: Clouds race wild in quiet bloom, The world beneath in twilight's gloom.

description: Palms stand still in twilight's breath, Guarding dreams as day meets death.

description: Deep **indigo blue** wings that seem to embrace the twilight, their elegant and soft texture dreaming of the stars.
